name: CalendarKit
description: Instant access to Google Calendar and essential utilities — all in one place, right from your toolbar.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; frame-src https://calendar.google.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' data: blob:
